primer: India Glycols Limited (NSE: INDIAGLYCO) carved out Potable Spirits and Ennature Biopharma on September 1, 2026. The listed entity now keeps Bio-based Specialties (BSPC), Industrial Gases, and a 49% Clariant IGL JV stake. Continuing sales run near ₹1,438 Cr at an 11% margin, while debt has halved to ₹826 Cr. At the November 13 close of ₹311.30, the stock trades at 18.5x headline and 21.4x tax-normalized P/E, not Screener's 9.27x mirage. Verdict: WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT in ₹269.72–₹277.94 (stop ₹243.25, base target ₹355.00, 2.22:1 R:R); NOT_HELD.
